items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment and approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, deployments, requeues, or experiments this cycle. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to a site; $0 site-attributed commission is not evidence of zero performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls and $901.90 cost, including 228 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and costs are period-misaligned, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent or incomplete, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning outcome or maximum cost-to-learn is defined. Treat clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, proposal counts, shipped output, and the 70-versus-44 pilot output comparison as operating or vanity metrics, not financial performance. Continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation work: reconcile attributable revenue to site/content/tracking identifiers, retain aggregate provider rows as unattributed, reconcile all cost categories including infrastructure, record approved ceilings, and define a measurable learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn. No duplicate telemetry request is warranted.

Handoff: continue the existing revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation work item only. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed; do not infer contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift from incomplete periods or activity counts. Escalate only when the minimum finance evidence is attached; do not create duplicate telemetry or financial work.
